purpose: Explicit, time-scoped facility/parent crosswalk for EPA TRI Basic Form R releases. This file is not a pollutant measurement.

authoritative_data_source.name: U.S. EPA TRI Basic Data Files, reporting year 2024
authoritative_data_source.retrieval_policy: Obtain official 2024 national or state EPA Basic CSV and record a SHA-256. Do not infer a current year from page crawl dates.

safeguards: TRIFID denotes a physical TRI reporting location, not corporate ownership or a corporate unit.
Time-bound ownership needs independent dated evidence; string similarity, EPA's current standardized parent field and climate producer labels are not enough.
Status candidate is never used for company attribution. The importer accepts only reviewed approved links with a matching reporting year.
TRI Basic Form A displays zero-filled release fields; exclude Form A from quantified Form R releases.
TRI chemical categories, element/compound combinations and dioxin grams cannot be silently consolidated.
Do not interpret an empty import or unreported substance as zero emissions.
Actual 2024 EPA TRI Basic CSV uses field headings TRIFD, CAS#, ST and 5.1–5.3, which require explicit audited aliases; unknown headers are rejected.
Approved TRIFID and year still require independently reviewed parent AND physical state/city/street match. A facility identifier alone is not enough.
Published files require SHA-256 and exact original EPA download URL; official reports are facility submissions, not exposure measurements or legal fault.

facilities.approval_scope: Facility identity and operator/parent link for calendar 2024 only; releases require the matching EPA TRI Basic Form R CSV. Not a company-wide emissions endorsement. Published source rows must also match physical TX/Baytown/5000 Bayway location fields.

evidence.detail: EPA docket exhibit lists TRIFID, address and chemical plant separately from olefins/refinery segments; table is contextual, not a 2024 release audit.
TCEQ Annual Operational Status Report year 2024 lists ExxonMobil Chemical Baytown Chemical Plant, 5000 Bayway Dr.
ExxonMobil 2024 Baytown Complex fact sheet states Exxon Mobil Corporation 100% ownership; applies to complex, and plant is separately identified in TCEQ record.

facilities.caveat: Part of a broader Baytown complex with additional TRI identifiers. Never sum those parts without verifying boundary overlap and distinct Form R submissions.
